subject: bug when computing map for large datasets

messages.author: db12a74f70728470
messages.subject: bug when computing map for large datasets
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to estimate a genetic map for a large crossing experiment
(actually a combination of several crosses, and some markers do not
overlap).

I simply read the data:
data<-read.cross(file="combined.csv", format="csv");

obtain the following message:

--Read the following data:
1103 individuals
94 markers
1 phenotypes
--Estimating genetic map
Error in imf(z$rf) : recursive default argument reference


after a long computation. Any idea if this is a known bug? I might have
made a mistake when I wrote the input file, but the software seems to
work well for smaller datasets so that is unlikely.


Thanks,

Vincent

messages.author: f388084a0de67b60
messages.subject: Re: bug when computing map for large datasets
parts:
I don't know what's going on.

I recommend reading the data in using estimate.map=FALSE, and then
estimating the map afterwards.

karl
